name: GhostDatePickerInput
description: Native text input for one picker value (single, start, or end). Preserves draft text, commits on Enter or blur, and links the format hint and errors.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Combines with the root `disabled` (for example from `GhostFieldControl`).

props.name: invalid
props.description: Combines with root errors (for example from `GhostFieldControl`).

props.name: part
props.description: Which value this input edits; range pickers need `start` and `end`.

props.name: required
props.description: Combines with the root `required` (for example from `GhostFieldControl`).
